Watch Heart

The official F-Droid repository for Watch Heart, a diary for every film, series and anime you watch, with monthly Instagram story recaps. Same signed APKs as the GitHub releases.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://inigo-code.github.io/watch-heart-site/fdroid/repo
